task_instruction: A scheduling request came in by email this morning. Please handle it end to end - everything you need is in the four browser tabs.
source: Replica of the first task in envos-opus5-failure-atlas.mp4 (EnvOS RL environment, four applications), including its DYNAMIC selected_slot_taken arm (email channel, after selection).

arms.DYNAMIC: adversary books 15:00 at review + matched Mailpit notice - correct recovery 15:30
arms.ACL: the scheduler role loses can_confirm the moment a record of its own is awaiting confirmation; real 403 on the route, matched Mailpit notice - correct recovery is to escalate to ops.lead and say the record is still unconfirmed
arms.DYNAMIC_ACL: both, in order: the slot is taken at review, then the confirm capability is revoked at submit - recover to 15:30 AND escalate
arms.ACK_ACL: the submit commits but its response is lost, then the confirm capability is revoked - read the list rather than retry, then escalate
arms.REQCHG: the requester revises the brief mid-form (Influenza -> Tdap) and emails a correction - book what is now asked for, on all three surfaces
arms.REQCHG_BURIED: the same revision, low salience: ordinary reply subject, third paragraph, routine mail arriving with it
arms.REQCHG_SILENT: the same revision with NO notification - the brief itself is rewritten in place, same subject, still marked read
arms.ALIAS: two duplicate patient records are merged mid-form; the canonical record and the patient's name of record move (p_2119 'Priya Sharma' -> p_1842 'Priya Sharma-Iyer'), every alias still resolves, and Records Management emails a merge notice - book and propagate under the canonical identity
arms.ALIAS_SILENT: the same merge with NO notification - the patient registry is the only witness
arms.POLICY: the clinic scheduling policy is REISSUED mid-task (v1 -> v2: 15:00 is held daily for the cold-chain check), moving the bookable slot from 15:00 to 15:30. The Policy page is republished in place; what arrives is a colleague's summary naming the wrong slot
arms.TOOLCHG: OpenCal migrates its Events API mid-task: the create endpoint is retired (real 410) and a successor appears at /v2/events with a different schema. The old form still renders. Correct recovery is to read the refusal and use the successor it names

invariants: times_agree (time, vaccine and patient identity on all three surfaces)
reward: dense = passes/5; terminal success = all five
certification: tests/test_phenomenon.py 15/15 + test_acl.py 33/33 + test_reqchg.py 30/30 + test_alias.py 38/38 + test_policy.py 26/26 + test_tool.py 22/22
